documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report recommending adoption of formal Rules of Procedure for the Board of Appeals.
documents.description: Staff report for the March 19, 2025 BZA meeting recommending approval of formal Rules of Procedure drafted by Lynn Board, Esq. Outlines six rationales: legal compliance, transparency, consistency, efficiency, public participation, and defined roles. Includes recommended motion: 'I move that the proposed Town of Sykesville Board of Appeals rules of procedure be adopted as presented.'

documents.name: Draft Rules of Procedure
documents.original_filename: Draft BOARD OF APPEALS Rules of Procedure
documents.synopsis: Draft Rules of Procedure for the Town of Sykesville Board of Appeals, adopted pursuant to §180-106.
documents.description: 14-section draft Rules of Procedure for the Sykesville Board of Appeals. Covers purpose, policy, definitions, officers (Chair/Vice-Chair election), meetings (Maryland Open Meetings Act compliance), general requirements, application filing, notice of hearings (§180-108.A), hearing conduct and evidence standards, decisions (§180-109, written resolution with findings of fact), reconsideration, ex-parte communication prohibition, rule amendment process, and conflict resolution with State law. Signature line for Chair Al McEvoy.

documents.name: BZA Minutes - 2025-03-19
documents.synopsis: BZA approved Rules of Procedure unanimously with three modifications: removal of prehearing requirements (7a-7c), 20-day pre-meeting filing deadline, and Town Clerk to administer oaths.
documents.description: Official minutes of the Sykesville Board of Zoning Appeals meeting held March 19, 2025. Chair McEvoy and Board Member Mueller present; third member absent. Lynn Board, Esq. (Levan and Ruff) provided new member training. The Board then reviewed and approved the draft Rules of Procedure with three modifications: (1) removal of section 7a-7c prehearing requirements, (2) change of filing deadline on page 4 to 20 days before a meeting, and (3) Town Clerk to administer oaths to those giving testimony. Motion by Mueller, seconded by McEvoy, carried unanimously. Adjourned 2:41 PM.
